title: Inbound Gateway
description: Expose your configured providers as a local OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoint so external tools can borrow Cognia's routing and credentials.
desktopOnlyNotice: The gateway needs an HTTP listener and is available only in the desktop app.
enabledHelp: Run the local HTTP server. Off by default; requires an API key.
requiresKey: Create an API key before enabling the gateway.
restartHint: Network changes (port, bind interface, allowlist, connect timeout, global rate limit) apply the next time you restart the listener.
bindHelp: Loopback keeps the gateway to this machine. LAN lets other devices on your network reach it — you must widen the IP allowlist below for that to take effect.
lanWarning: LAN binding exposes the gateway to your local network. Keep the IP allowlist tight and every key scoped — only allow-listed IPs with a valid key get through.
connectHelp: Point any OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible client at the gateway by setting one of these environment variables.
authNote: Use an API key as the credential — Authorization: Bearer '<key>' or x-api-key: '<key>'.
keysHelp: Issue one scoped key per external tool. Each can be limited to specific models, given an expiry and its own rate limit, and disabled or deleted independently.
keysEmpty: No keys yet. Create one to authenticate external tools.
newKeyReveal: Copy this key now — for your security it is shown only once.
deleteKeyConfirm: Delete this key? Tools using it will stop working immediately.
keyModelsHelp: Comma-separated model or alias ids this key may call. Empty = every exposed model.
keyExpiryHelp: Leave blank for a key that never expires.
keyRateLimitHelp: Per-key request budget. Blank = only the global limit applies.
keyQuotaHelp: Cumulative input+output token budget for this key. Blank = unlimited. The gateway rejects the key once it is spent.
reliabilityHelp: Timeouts, failover retries, and who may connect.
allowlistHelp: Only these IPv4 addresses (CIDR) may connect. Defaults to loopback-only; widen it for LAN peers.
connectTimeoutHelp: Bounds a hung upstream connection on every request, streaming included.
requestTimeoutHelp: Total cap for non-streaming requests. 0 disables it; streaming responses are never capped.
maxRetriesHelp: Cap on candidates tried per request. 0 = walk the whole fallback chain.
retryStatusCodesHelp: Upstream HTTP statuses that fail over to the next provider instead of surfacing.
exposureHelp: Control which models this gateway advertises and serves.
exposedModelsHelp: Only these model or alias ids are listed and served. Empty = expose everything configured.
hideRawModelsHelp: Hide raw provider model ids from /v1/models — advertise routing aliases only. Direct provider:model calls still work.
logHelp: Every inbound request, kept across restarts.
